{"settings":"{
  "workbench.iconTheme": "vscode-icons",
  "[python]": {
    "breadcrumbs.showEnums": true,
    "editor.formatOnType": true,
    "diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace": true
  },
  "workbench.colorTheme": "Bearded Theme Vivid Purple",
  "emmet.useInlineCompletions": true,
  "emmet.showSuggestionsAsSnippets": true,
  "emmet.triggerExpansionOnTab": true,
  "editor.unicodeHighlight.allowedLocales": {
    "ru": true
  },
  "cmake.configureOnOpen": true,
  "code-runner.runInTerminal": true,
  "C_Cpp.files.exclude": {
    "**/.vscode": true,
    "**/.vs": true
  },
  "cmake.showOptionsMovedNotification": false,
  "editor.linkedEditing": true,
  "terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windows": "Git Bash",
  "python.analysis.packageIndexDepths": [
    {
      "name": "sklearn",
      "depth": 2
    },
    {
      "name": "matplotlib",
      "depth": 2
    },
    {
      "name": "scipy",
      "depth": 2
    },
    {
      "name": "django",
      "depth": 3,
      "includeAllSymbols": true
    },
    {
      "name": "flask",
      "depth": 2
    },
    {
      "name": "fastapi",
      "depth": 2
    }
  ],
  "terminal.integrated.cursorBlinking": true,
  "terminal.integrated.cursorStyle": "line",
  "editor.acceptSuggestionOnEnter": "off",
  "editor.suggest.preview": true,
  "editor.suggest.snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions": true,
  "explorer.compactFolders": false,
  "html.format.templating": true,
  "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
  "editor.indentSize": "tabSize",
  "window.commandCenter": false,
  "vsicons.dontShowNewVersionMessage": true,
  "terminal.integrated.fontFamily": "'FiraCode Nerd Font'",
  "debug.console.fontFamily": "'FiraCode Nerd Font'",
  "workbench.settings.applyToAllProfiles": [
    "debug.console.fontFamily",
    "editor.fontFamily"
  ],
  "editor.fontFamily": "'FiraCode Nerd Font', 'monospace', monospace",
  "editor.fontWeight": 600,
  "terminal.external.linuxExec": "kitty",
  "debug.terminal.clearBeforeReusing": true,
  "code-runner.executorMap": {
    "cpp": "cd $dir && g++ $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && kitty -- bash -c './$fileNameWithoutExt ; read line'",
    "javascript": "node",
    "java": "cd $dir && javac $fileName && java $fileNameWithoutExt",
    "c": "cd $dir && gcc $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && kitty -- bash -c './$fileNameWithoutExt ; read line'",
    "zig": "zig run",
    "objective-c": "cd $dir && gcc -framework Cocoa $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "php": "php",
    "python": "python -u",
    "perl": "perl",
    "perl6": "perl6",
    "ruby": "ruby",
    "go": "go run",
    "lua": "lua",
    "groovy": "groovy",
    "powershell": "powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -File",
    "bat": "cmd /c",
    "shellscript": "bash",
    "fsharp": "fsi",
    "csharp": "scriptcs",
    "vbscript": "cscript //Nologo",
    "typescript": "ts-node",
    "coffeescript": "coffee",
    "scala": "scala",
    "swift": "swift",
    "julia": "julia",
    "crystal": "crystal",
    "ocaml": "ocaml",
    "r": "Rscript",
    "applescript": "osascript",
    "clojure": "lein exec",
    "haxe": "haxe --cwd $dirWithoutTrailingSlash --run $fileNameWithoutExt",
    "rust": "cd $dir && rustc $fileName && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "racket": "racket",
    "scheme": "csi -script",
    "ahk": "autohotkey",
    "autoit": "autoit3",
    "dart": "dart",
    "pascal": "cd $dir && fpc $fileName && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "d": "cd $dir && dmd $fileName && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "haskell": "runghc",
    "nim": "nim compile --verbosity:0 --hints:off --run",
    "lisp": "sbcl --script",
    "kit": "kitc --run",
    "v": "v run",
    "sass": "sass --style expanded",
    "scss": "scss --style expanded",
    "less": "cd $dir && lessc $fileName $fileNameWithoutExt.css",
    "FortranFreeForm": "cd $dir && gfortran $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "fortran-modern": "cd $dir && gfortran $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "fortran_fixed-form": "cd $dir && gfortran $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "fortran": "cd $dir && gfortran $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "sml": "cd $dir && sml $fileName",
    "mojo": "mojo run",
    "erlang": "escript",
    "spwn": "spwn build",
    "pkl": "cd $dir && pkl eval -f yaml $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt.yaml",
    "gleam": "gleam run -m $fileNameWithoutExt"
  },
  "terminal.explorerKind": "external",
  "editor.defaultFormatter": "ms-python.pylint",
  "security.workspace.trust.untrustedFiles": "open",
  "editor.experimentalInlineEdit.enabled": true,
  "debugpy.showPythonInlineValues": true,
  "too-long-line-limit.hardLimit": 100,
  "editor.rulers": [
    80,
    100
  ],
  "too-long-line-limit.softLimitSeverity": "3",
  "too-long-line-limit.hardLimitSeverity": "2",
  "editor.matchBrackets": false,
  "git.autofetch": true,
  "files.trimTrailingWhitespace": true,
  "[markdown]": {
    "diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace": true
  },
  "workbench.panel.showLabels": false,
  "editor.minimap.enabled": false,
  "editor.snippetSuggestions": "top",
  "C_Cpp.suggestSnippets": false,
  "dotnet.server.useOmnisharp": true,
  "editor.inlineSuggest.syntaxHighlightingEnabled": true,
  "editor.suggest.shareSuggestSelections": true,
  "editor.suggestSelection": "recentlyUsedByPrefix",
  "python.defaultInterpreterPath": "/usr/bin/python",
  "python.locator": "js",
  "window.confirmSaveUntitledWorkspace": false,
  "gitlens.advanced.messages": {
    "suppressRebaseSwitchToTextWarning": true
  }
}
"}
